hideProduct.title: Hide item
hideProduct.description: Afterwards the item is only visible to the seller, the event team and admins. Questions and price offers are no longer possible.

hideEvent.title: Block event
hideEvent.description: The event disappears for visitors and sellers, nobody can join any more. The organizer team can still manage it.

deleteQuestion.title: Delete question
deleteQuestion.description: Question and answer are deleted permanently. The text stays in the log.

banUser.title: Block user
banUser.description: The account is blocked and logged out immediately. The person can no longer log in.

dismissReport.title: Dismiss report
dismissReport.description: The content stays visible. The reporting person receives your reason by email.

moderate.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. breach of § 5 (2) of the terms: offensive description
moderate.reasonHint: The person concerned receives the reason by email. It is also stored in the moderation log.

banner.title: Admin mode
banner.text: You manage this event as an administrator with all organizer rights. Changes take effect immediately.

overview.pendingHint: Check public bazaars before they are published
overview.legalHint: Imprint, privacy policy or terms are missing or contain placeholders
overview.title: Administration
overview.subtitle: Moderate content, approve bazaars and keep an eye on the platform.
overview.how1: Anyone can report items, questions and events. Reports appear under “Reports” and you get an email.
overview.how2: Restricted content is hidden, not deleted. The person concerned still sees it, receives the reason by email and can object.
overview.how3: As an admin you can manage every event like an organizer: intake, cash desk, settings.
overview.how4: Every decision is in the log with its reason.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Content reported by users. Decide with a reason; sellers and reporters are informed by email.
reports.alreadyRestricted: The content has already been restricted.
reports.deletedMeanwhile: The content has been deleted in the meantime.

events.title: Events
events.subtitle: Approve public bazaars, block problematic events and manage every event like an organizer.
events.rejectText: Please give a reason why this event is rejected. The organizer receives this information.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Search accounts, look at their content and block them for violations.
users.deleteText: For deletion requests by email: name, contact details, sign-in data and unsold items are deleted right away; the account cannot be reactivated. Sales remain without a profile for the settlements. For suspended accounts the address stays blocked from signing up for two years.
users.deleteIsOrganizer: The account organizes a running or upcoming event.
users.deleteHasOpenSales: A bazaar still holds items of the account, or its payout is open.

content.title: Content
content.subtitle: Search and moderate all items and public questions of the platform.

messages.title: Contact requests
messages.subtitle: Messages from the contact form, including objections to moderation decisions.

log.title: Log
log.subtitle: All moderation decisions with reasons, newest first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Name, contact and logo of this BazarPro instance.
settings.name: Name
settings.nameHint: Shown on the home page. Leave empty for “Bazaar”.
settings.startOverview: Overview with name, logo and all bazaars
settings.startCurrent: Straight to the running or next bazaar
settings.startHint: If there is no running or planned bazaar, the overview is always shown.
settings.analyticsText: Optional: visitor numbers without cookies with your own Plausible instance or plausible.io. While it is active, the privacy policy names it automatically (block {{directive}}). For plausible.io you need a data processing agreement.
settings.envHint: Empty fields take PLAUSIBLE_DOMAIN and PLAUSIBLE_API_HOST from the .env. Status: {{status}}.
settings.mode: Mode: {{mode}}. It is set during setup via BAZARPRO_MODE.
settings.logoUploadFailed: The logo could not be uploaded.

legal.title: Legal texts
legal.subtitle: Imprint, privacy policy and terms of this site. Every change is saved as a new version.
legal.missingSingle: Not created yet. The page shows visitors a notice.
legal.missingPlatform: Not created yet. The page shows the text supplied by bazarpro.de.
legal.placeholders: The text still contains placeholders in double square brackets, e.g. [[Name des Vereins]]. Please replace all of them and have the text checked legally before the page is used publicly.
